hits.title: Leave policy
hits.heading: Annual leave
hits.text: Full-time employees get 24 days of paid annual leave per calendar year, plus public holidays. Up to 5 unused days can be carried over to the next year and must be used by 31 March.

hits.title: Leave policy
hits.heading: Sick leave
hits.text: Employees get 12 days of paid sick leave per year. A doctor's note is required for absences longer than 2 consecutive days.

hits.title: Leave policy
hits.heading: Requesting leave
hits.text: Request leave in the HR portal at least 2 weeks in advance for absences of 3 days or more. Your manager approves it within 3 working days.

hits.title: Leave policy
hits.heading: Parental leave
hits.text: Birthing parents get 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave. Other parents get 6 weeks of fully paid leave, which can be taken within the first year.

title: Stolen laptop, urgent

raw_reply: Report it to the IT service desk within 1 hour on extension 4357 or it-help@halcyon.example; IT will wipe it remotely [IT-SEC#2].
